_meta.source: Shape copied from the real BoydGaming SmartRecruiters payload (src/testdata/smartrecruiters-sample.json, fetched live 2026-11-18). Company and jobs are fictional (Acme) for the canned test.

additionalInformation.text: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. You will work with a friendly team and have clear goals and regular feedback.
additionalInformation.title: Additional Information

companyDescription.text: Acme Corp is a fully remote company serving customers across the United States.
companyDescription.title: Company Description

jobDescription.text:
This is a fully remote position. Work from anywhere in the United States — remote in all 50 states; no travel or office attendance required.

We are looking for a motivated team member to join our team. You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, and help resolve questions about products and services. This is a full-time position with benefits including health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan.
jobDescription.title: Job Description

qualifications.text: Strong written communication skills and attention to detail are important. Experience with customer support tools is helpful but not required. We provide training and the equipment you need to do the job well.
qualifications.title: Qualifications

companyDescription.text: Acme Corp runs a hybrid office in Chicago, Illinois.
companyDescription.title: Company Description

jobDescription.text: This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago office 3 days a week, working from home the other 2 days. You will manage office operations, supplies, and vendor relationships for our Chicago headquarters team.
jobDescription.title: Job Description

qualifications.text: Office management experience and strong organizational skills required.
qualifications.title: Qualifications

companyDescription.text: Acme Corp operates a distribution warehouse in Dallas, Texas.
companyDescription.title: Company Description

jobDescription.text:
This role is based in our Dallas office and warehouse 5 days a week. You will pick, pack, and ship orders, operate a forklift, and keep inventory records accurate for our Dallas distribution team. This is an on-site position; remote work is not available for this role.

Shifts are Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm, with occasional overtime during peak season. Benefits include health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan.
jobDescription.title: Job Description

qualifications.text: Warehouse experience and a valid forklift certification are preferred. You must be able to lift up to 50 pounds and stand for long periods.
qualifications.title: Qualifications
